settings.heading: Old Doha Port
settings.text:
A Momentary Pause… for an Exceptional Return in October 2025

Dear Valued Guests,

Nestled elegantly at the Old Doha Port, NOIR Café has gracefully painted memorable moments upon the gentle waves, infused with aromatic coffee, refined pastries, and Qatar’s first-ever floating café experience.

In our continuous pursuit of perfection, NOIR Café will temporarily close its doors at the Old Doha Port for renovations and enhancements. This brief interlude will allow us to craft an even more captivating and sophisticated ambiance for your future visits.

While we prepare to unveil this renewed chapter in October 2025, we warmly invite you to continue enjoying the NOIR experience at our other locations in West Walk and Al Hazm, where elegance and detail await you every day.

Thank you for your unwavering support. We eagerly await your return to Old Doha Port—refined, reimagined, and ready to enchant once more.

Warm regards,
NOIR Café
Address: Old Doha Port, Doha
